waitingOn.STATION: Next: the station reports the payment.

paymentSummary.loadFailed: Payment progress is not available right now.
paymentSummary.manage: Manage payments in the job order

none.waiting: No action is needed right now.
none.technicalDone: The work is approved. The job is not complete until every installment is confirmed.

provider.confirmPayment: Confirm that you received the reported payment (see Payments below).
provider.waitStationPayment: Waiting for the station to report the payment.
provider.assignOperator: Assign an operator so the work can start.
provider.work: Carry out the work. Operators record visits and evidence.
provider.rework: The station asked for rework. Fix the issues and submit again.
provider.waitReview: Submitted. Waiting for the station to review the completion.
provider.startWork: Start the work: check in on site. Operators then record notes and photos.
provider.submitReport: Evidence is ready. Write the final maintenance report and submit it for review.
provider.waitMaintenance: Report submitted. Waiting for the Maintenance Manager to review it.
provider.waitOperations: The Maintenance Manager approved it. Waiting for the Operations Manager's final approval.

station.reportPayment: Report the installment payment with a transfer reference or receipt (see Payments below).
station.waitProviderConfirm: Payment reported. Waiting for the provider to confirm receipt. Do not pay again.
station.legacyPayment: Confirm the payment you sent (historical single payment, see below).
station.review: Review the completed work: approve and close, or request rework.
station.waitProviderWork: The provider is carrying out the work.
station.paymentRejected: The payment was rejected. Contact the provider.
station.reviewMaintenance: Review the provider's final report: approve it for the Operations Manager, or return it with a comment.
station.reviewOperations: Give the final approval or return the work with a comment. Approval makes the final installment due.
station.waitMaintenance: Waiting for the Maintenance Manager to review the final report.
station.waitOperations: Waiting for the Operations Manager's final approval.
